needed.evidence: People are walking on a narrow, unpaved strip of land next to the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built, paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and umbrellas completely obstruct the walking area.
